The '''Tech-Adepts''' of [[Yablari/Legends|Yablari]] was a group of [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and data experts active during the [[Galactic War]], known for their [[Siege at Paigu]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] the Tech-Adepts were hired by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] to retrieve records from the [[Tarlam]] City Archives.
